plan.build_control: Identical SDK, compiler, fixed source path and flags to R109. No production installation.
plan.hypothesis: Stack temporary allocated once in event loop; Client retains only exact incomplete tails.
plan.statistical_unit: Independent physical-router block; paired ratios within a block. Requests are not independent repetitions.
plan.analysis: Exploratory screen, no superiority or equivalence verdict. Preserve every adverse direction and complete raw archive. No pooling older runs.
plan.retention_rule: RssAnon growth at 64 connections must be <=38.4 KiB in both repeats. No acceptance before CPU and correctness checks. Rejection preserves results.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on any identity, correctness, health, cleanup or collection failure; preserve the failed window.
plan.production: C throughout; private mount/PID/net namespace, guarded lifetime and cleanup per window.
plan.pss: Unavailable on this kernel; write NA, never zero.
plan.readiness: Exact HELLO, PING DATA and STATUS validation for every held connection; daemon fd count must increase by N and return to baseline.

limitations: Exploratory paired blocks only. RSS counters may be imprecise; no PSS or kernel-buffer/peak claim. Event loop clocks do not measure per-request tail latency. No pooling earlier runs.
